apiKey.keyFor: Bilingual translation (双语沉浸式翻译) uses an OpenAI-compatible API with a user-entered API key
apiKey.worksWithout: Fetching arXiv HTML, hiding page elements, style repair and Google Scholar search need no key

evidence.quote: 配置翻译服务商：`API Base URL`、`API Key`、`Model`、`RPM`、`Temperature`。

checkNote: The defaults 'translationApiKey", ""' and 'translationApiBaseUrl", "https://api.openai.com/v1"' put the key only on translation; fetching HTML, hiding elements and Scholar search do not use it. The base URL can be edited, but no pack text names a local model, so 'unknown' is right.
